---
title: "Contributing in your role"
---

*Written for version 0.1.14. Sources: [onboard-collaborator](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/skills/onboard-collaborator/SKILL.md), [onboarding](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/references/onboarding.md), [writing the analysis plan](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/references/analysis-plan.md), [the AGENTS.md template](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/assets/AGENTS.md), [GitHub workflow](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/references/github-workflow.md), [review-analysis](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/skills/review-analysis/SKILL.md), [blind reviewers](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/blob/main/plugin/references/reviewers.md).*

The plugin assumes no role. It starts from what you want to contribute and what you already know, and offers the help that fits you. A project may have several people leading parts of it and no single lead, and the PI may use the plugin too. The roles below are common patterns, not boxes: one person can hold several, and each project fills them its own way.

Two rules hold in every role. Only a named **decider** settles a scientific question. And every change reaches the main branch through a **pull request**, a proposed change that others can see before it is merged.

- [Project lead](roles-lead.qmd)
- [PI or maintainer](roles-pi.qmd)
- [Decider](roles-decider.qmd)
- [Clinician adviser](roles-clinician.qmd)
- [Statistician](roles-statistician.qmd)
